labs.name: Idaho Bureau of Laboratories (state lab)
labs.detail: EPA lab ID ID00018. Certificates posted by the Idaho Bureau of Laboratories: Chemistry (EPA Region 10 letter, March 24, 2025; renewal due 2027); Microbiology (EPA Region 10 letter, May 23, 2025; renewal due 2027).
labs.source_name: IBL certificate folder: Chemistry
labs.source_name_2: IBL Private Well Owner Drinking Water Analysis Submission Form (revised 08/21/2024)
labs.note: The state lab is certified by EPA Region 10, not by its own program. It takes private well samples with its Private Well Owner submission form (see fees in the Idaho section above). EPA lab number ID00018 is printed on that form. Other certificate files: Microbiology (EPA Region 10 letter (https://publicdocuments.dhw.idaho.gov/WebLink/DocView.aspx?id=36257&dbid=0&repo=PUBLIC-DOCUMENTS).
